dataset.split: 75% Stratified Train (7,500: 7,350 Maj, 150 Min), 25% Test (2,500: 2,450 Maj, 50 Min)

models.name: Baseline Random Forest (class_weight=None)
models.description: Standard unweighted Random Forest. Achieves high nominal accuracy but low recall on rare positive events as minority splits minimize overall Gini impurity.

models.name: Random Forest (class_weight='balanced')
models.description: Scales Gini impurity split criteria inversely proportional to global class frequencies w_c = N / (K * N_c), boosting minority sample influence during node splits.

models.name: Random Forest (class_weight='balanced_subsample')
models.description: Computes class weights dynamically inside each bootstrap sample, automatically compensating for localized minority sampling variations across trees.

models.name: Random Oversampling (ROS) + Random Forest
models.description: Duplicates minority training samples with replacement to reach parity. Increases minority sensitivity, but identical replicates risk narrow leaf overfitting.

models.name: Random Undersampling (RUS) + Random Forest
models.description: Randomly discards majority class instances to match minority count. Trains extremely fast but incurs massive information loss by discarding majority observations.

models.name: SMOTE + Random Forest
models.description: Generates synthetic minority examples via linear interpolation between k-nearest neighbors in feature space, constructing continuous minority decision regions.

models.name: Balanced Random Forest (imblearn)
models.description: Draws a bootstrap sample of the minority class and an equal-sized random subsample of the majority class independently for every individual tree in the forest.
